name: Tandospirone
summary: Tandospirone, sold under the brand name Sediel, is an anxiolytic and antidepressant medication used in Japan and China, where it is marketed by Dainippon Sumitomo Pharma. It is a member of the azapirone class of drugs and is closely related to other azapirones like buspirone and gepirone.

pharmacology.text: Tandospirone acts as a potent and selective 5-HT1A receptor partial agonist, with a Ki affinity value of 27 ± 5 nM and approximately 55 to 85% intrinsic activity.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT1A receptor partial agonist; Anxiolytic; Antidepressant

uses.text: Tandospirone, sold under the brand name Sediel, is an anxiolytic and antidepressant medication used in Japan and China, where it is marketed by Dainippon Sumitomo Pharma. Tandospirone was introduced for medical use in Japan in 1996 and in China in 2004.

summaryZh: 坦度螺酮（英語：Tandospirone），是一款在中國與日本經常被用作為抗焦慮藥與抗抑鬱藥的藥物。坦度螺酮為氮哌酮，哌嗪一員，化學結構上與丁螺環酮相似。
summaryZhHans: 坦度螺酮（英语：Tandospirone），是一款在中国与日本经常被用作为抗焦虑药与抗抑郁药的药物。坦度螺酮为氮哌酮，哌嗪一员，化学结构上与丁螺环酮相似。

sideEffects.en: Like buspirone, it can cause dizziness, drowsiness, nausea and headache.
sideEffects.zh: 與丁螺環酮一樣，它可能造成頭暈、嗜睡、噁心與頭痛。
sideEffects.zhHans: 与丁螺环酮一样，它可能造成头晕、嗜睡、恶心与头痛。

fact.en: Tandospirone is a close cousin of buspirone. Both are azapirones, anxiety medicines that act through serotonin receptors rather than through GABA like the benzodiazepines.
fact.zh: 坦度螺酮是丁螺環酮的近親。兩者都屬於氮雜螺酮類，這類抗焦慮藥是透過血清素受體作用，而不是像苯二氮平類那樣透過GABA。
fact.zhHans: 坦度螺酮是丁螺环酮的近亲。两者都属于氮杂螺酮类，这类抗焦虑药是通过血清素受体作用，而不是像苯二氮平类那样通过GABA。
